description: This source file implements an HTTP filter in Java that enforces JWT-based authentication for admin API endpoints. It intercepts requests, checks for proper Authorization headers, verifies JWT tokens using a secret key and optional issuer, and blocks unauthorized access with appropriate responses.

classes.name: AdminAuthFilter
classes.description: A filter class that intercepts HTTP requests to verify JWT tokens for admin endpoints.

methods.name: AdminAuthFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with authentication properties.

methods.name: shouldNotFilter
methods.description: Determines whether the current request path should bypass the filter, based on whether it targets admin routes.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Main filter logic: checks for the presence and validity of a JWT token in the Authorization header, and rejects or allows the request accordingly.

methods.name: writeUnauthorized
methods.description: Helper method to send a 401 Unauthorized response with a JSON message.
